diagnosis.reasoning: Queueing exploded (0 -> ~710 waiting, p99 queue time 0.3s -> 119s) while the engine sat nearly idle: running requests fell 86%, KV usage fell 70%, and per-iteration GPU-side costs (prefill_time_p99, prefill_kv_computed, inter-token latency) and prefix-cache hit rate were completely unchanged. That combination — huge admission queue with an underfed batch and no GPU or cache pressure — points to a host-side/API-path bottleneck starving the scheduler rather than any GPU, KV, or preemption pathology; the throughput and arrival-rate drops are downstream backpressure, not a workload increase.  batch_composition and queueing are ranked below as the observable consequences of that stall.
